L12_O1a_O1.description: Prove nonperturbative global existence/uniqueness theorem for the full all-coupling FIN RG flow derived from complete FIN action (beyond proxy truncation).

L12_O1b_O1.description: Prove global all-t fixed-point/stability theorem for the full nonperturbative all-coupling FIN RG system derived from complete FIN action (including UV behavior without hidden truncation/scope restriction).

acceptance_criteria.T1: Constructive derivation of full nonperturbative all-coupling FIN RG flow from complete FIN action.
acceptance_criteria.T2: Global well-posedness theorem (existence/uniqueness) for all physical scales t>=0.
acceptance_criteria.T3: Global fixed-point/stability theorem all-t for full derived flow, including UV behavior.
acceptance_criteria.T4: No hidden scope truncation; explicit bound-control lemmas and theorem dependencies.
acceptance_criteria.T5: Machine-checkable theorem package attached with reproducible proof object hashes.
